name: rune_keening_cage_bone_thicket
for: Keening Cage 'bone thicket' / 'thicket again' (side.rs KEENER_BLOWS, Motion::Rune, reach -0.9..0.9 m, height 0..2.2 m)
notes: Ground patch (~2 m) shows heaving soil and bone flecks first, then a violet crack seeping across it (KC's core violet) with chips hopping (frames 1-14), frame 15 the thicket bursts up (the hit): seven barbed bone spikes, dark at the root and pale at the tip, the tallest ~2.2 m, leaning out in a fan, with bone chips, dust and violet wisps; they crumble in blocks and sink by frame 23. Built at about 40 px/m (Keening Cage 135-147 px / 3.6 m). 24 frames @ 12 fps.
